title: Monday Motivation:
caption:
Monday Motivation:
Sometimes, saying “no” to what feels good today is actually saying “yes” to the life you want tomorrow.
Discipline is not deprivation. It is choosing what matters most.
There will always be temporary pleasures but the peace that comes from financial security, meaningful relationships, good health, purposeful work and a life built on your own values—that lasts.
So this Monday, ask yourself:
“What am I willing to postpone today so that I can build something that lasts tomorrow?”

Stay focused. Stay patient. Keep building. 

#MondayMotivation 
#StayFocused 
#PurposefulLiving

title: Some people ask me, “What’s the purpose of going to the gym?”
hook: Some people ask me, “What’s the purpose of going to the gym?”
caption:
2026/8/31

Some people ask me, “What’s the purpose of going to the gym?”
The answer is: to keep fit, reduce stress, strengthen both body and mind, achieve a healthy body, have beautiful skin, become more attractive, reach my ideal body, experience self-actualization, continue loving myself—or simply just for fun.
There are endless reasons.

So, to turn the question around: Why don’t you work out?

「何のためにジム行ってるの？」と聞かれる時があります。スリムでいたい、ストレス解消、体力と心の向上、健康維持、美容効果、モテたい、理想の身体を手に入れたい、自己実現、自分を好きでいたい、ただ単に楽しいなど無限の答えがあります。

「なぜあなたは筋トレをしてないの？」

と逆に聞きたい。

#consistency #growthmindset #selfdiscipline
#一貫性 #自己規律
